verdict.rationale: Tavily documents its own bulk capabilities. Extract accepts up to 20 URLs per request and reports per-URL failures separately in failed_results. Crawl and Map traverse hundreds of site paths in parallel within a single call, and an async Python client is available for concurrent workloads. missing for 10: no batch/multi-query Search endpoint, a hard 20-URL cap per Extract request, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk usage at scale.
